program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((colors (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (grid-colors g))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list colors)])
      (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
        (if (= (length pts) 2)
            (let* ((a (first pts)) (b (second pts))
                   (r0 (min (first a) (first b))) (r1 (max (first a) (first b)))
                   (c0 (min (second a) (second b))) (c1 (max (second a) (second b))))
              (paint-cells out (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1) color))
            out)))))
